input.extraction_context: import ZIP as new slot, later activation

notes: D-006 correction, not oracle parity. The ZIP spec's own entry-name convention uses forward slashes, but archives built by Windows tooling sometimes store backslash-separated paths; a traversal check that only recognizes '../' would miss '..\' entirely. Since Phase 6's world-mutation archives can be created or consumed on any of the three supported platforms (msc2-engineering.md), the extractor must normalize both separators before path-containment checking, on every platform -- not just when running on Windows -- so a backslash-traversal entry crafted on one platform can't slip past validation running on another.
